items.title: [Security Vulnerability] OS Command Injection in /git command via shell=True
items.desc:
### Issue

Description:
A critical OS Command Injection vulnerability exists in the cmd_git method within aider/commands.py. items.title: Security: a failed approval-hook re-initialization during reload leaves the gateway serving with tools ungated
items.desc:
## Summary

PicoClaw supports process approval hooks: before a tool runs, the gateway asks a hook whether the call is approved, and a hook that denies the call produces `exec_skipped`. When the gateway reloads (the `/reload` channel command or a configuration reload), it tears down the old hook and re-initializes the configured hooks. If re-initialization fails, the agent records a warning but the gateway still reports the reload as successful and continues serving with no hooks mounted. Every s...

items.llm_reproduction: 触发 /reload 或配置重载，并让配置的 approval hook 初始化失败；此时 gateway 仍报告重载成功且无 hooks mounted；随后调用工具可见审批步骤被跳过。
